about: Live-ingestion samples for Walnut DataBridge Demo Day. Synthetic only (Company A). Every sample was checked against databridge/fixtures/enterprise/world.json: channel or folder exists, sign_in_as is a member / has write access, proof_phrase is absent from the world (case-insensitive). 'before_question' gets the constant refusal today. Regenerate the proof with docs/finals/live_kit/check_absent.py.
refusal: I couldn't find an answer to that in the sources you can access.

note_kinds.slack-note: POST /sim/add-document as the signed-in person; the poster must be a current member of the channel.
note_kinds.upload: POST /sim/upload-file as the signed-in person; needs write on the Drive folder (admin.it may write to any folder). Files live in /finals/live_kit/files/ and are built by docs/finals/live_kit/make_files.py.
